mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_device_accounts ( id, device_id, user_id, authorized_at, last_used_at, reauth_required, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{deviceId}, #{userId}, #{authorizedAt}, #{lastUsedAt}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_used_at = VALUES(last_used_at), reauth_required = 0, reauth_reason = NULL, revoked_at = NULL, revoked_reason = NULL, updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
